title: 4th ELA Pacing Support
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Nov 9–13 weekly block, Unit 3: Art and the Great Depression] I can identify the main idea and supporting details in an informational text. I can explain the author’s purpose for writing about the era.
[Nov 30–Dec 4 weekly block, Unit 3: Art and the Great Depression] I can explain how an author’s word choice creates a specific mood. I can summarize complex informational text.
[Nov 30–Dec 4 weekly block, Standards] 4.L.V.3, 4.T.T.4
[Nov 30–Dec 4 weekly block, Magnetic Literacy] Magnetic Literacy: Unit 3, Sessions 14-19
[Nov 30–Dec 4 weekly block, Support / PEC] Read words (give an example, or use it in a sentence as needed) from the text and have them slide or point to the area on the mood meter they feel these words belong (ex. Hardship, struggle, gloomy, poverty).
[Dec 7–11 weekly block, Unit 3: Art and the Great Depression] I can integrate information from visuals and text to deepen my understanding. I can write an organized paragraph with evidence. I can identify a poem's theme.
[Dec 7–11 weekly block, Standards] 4.T.T.2, 4.T.C.2
[Dec 7–11 weekly block, Magnetic Literacy] Magnetic Literacy: Unit 3, Sessions 20-25
